subject: Approval-request: Medilink co-marketing spotlight + logo usage
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@medilinkhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Approval-request: Medilink co-marketing spotlight + logo usage

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — really enjoyed the conversation about how Medilink is using Redwood to reduce inference costs and tighten SLAs for clinical decisioning. As discussed, we'd love to publish a short co-marketing spotlight (case study + quote) highlighting the work and include the Medilink logo on the landing page and PDF collateral.

Attached: medilink_case_draft_v1.pdf (draft copy) and medilink_logo_pack.zip (SVG / PNG / guidelines).

High-level asks:
- Confirm permission to publish the attached spotlight on our site and in sales collateral
- Approve use of the Medilink logo (we can use a monochrome lockup if preferred)
- Approve the short quote highlighted on page 2 (we can anonymize or attribute only to role/title)

If you prefer, we can send a one-page release via DocuSign. Target publish window is early October. Please let me know any edits or restrictions — happy to accommodate.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@medilinkhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval-request: Medilink co-marketing spotlight + logo usage

Hi Sean,

Thanks for sending this over — the draft looks solid and we appreciate the spotlight. A couple of items from our side before we can approve:

1) Quote removal: the paragraph on page 2 that references patient percentage reductions is too granular for publishing right now. Can we remove the specific metric and instead say: "significant improvements in throughput and cost"?
2) Logo usage: Procurement/legal have asked that we only allow the Medilink wordmark (monochrome) in a small lockup on the asset; please do not use full-color gradient marks or place the logo on imagery.
3) Procurement review: I need to run the release by procurement for their standard co-marketing language. I'll attach our redlines.

I've attached Medilink_redline.docx with our recommended edits. I can try to expedite procurement but it may take 24-48 hours. We are comfortable with a short, non-attributed quote attributed to "Medilink — Partnerships" or just the title.

If you can incorporate the redline and send an updated release, we can sign. Alternatively, feel free to send the DocuSign link and I'll shepherd internally.

Best,
Jordan Miller
Director, Partnerships | Medilink Health
jordan.miller@medilinkhealth.com

Thanks for the forward, Sean. Reviewed Jordan's redlines — reasonable asks. A suggested path:

1) Copy edits: remove the specific metric and replace with: "significant improvements in throughput and cost" (as Jordan suggested).
2) Quote: offer two options to Jordan — (A) anonymize the quote and attribute to "Partnerships, Medilink" or (B) use the trimmed quote with title-only attribution (e.g., "Director, Partnerships").
3) Logo: agree to monochrome wordmark lockup at 72px minimum height, on white / neutral backgrounds only. No gradient/full-color usage.
4) Release: attach a one-page release that matches our standard co-marketing language with a clause limiting use to digital and PDF collateral for 24 months unless otherwise renewed. Attached: redwood_medilink_release_v1.docx.

Legal note (Laura): Please confirm the 24-month term is acceptable; if procurement insists on perpetual rights we should ask for a limited license instead.

I'll update the draft quickly and we can send via DocuSign. Sean — if you can nudge Jordan on procurement turnaround, we'll be ready to send the release today.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Procurement cleared the language overnight — thanks for accommodating the edits. We are happy to approve publication with the following agreed points:

- Replace the specific metric with "significant improvements in throughput and cost"
- Use monochrome wordmark lockup only; minimum size 72px; no placement on photography
- Attribution: "Director, Partnerships (Medilink)" is fine for the quote
- Rights: 24-month limited license for digital/PDF collateral

I've attached the signed release (Medilink_release_signed.pdf). You can proceed with publication and the assets as discussed. Please send final URL/asset back for our records once live.

Best,
